profile.summary: Missoula Children's Theatre (MCT Inc.) is a nonprofit arts organization based in Missoula, Montana. It provides theatre education and live productions for children and adults. Its Red Truck Tour sends touring teams to communities around the world, and it also runs local youth programs and a community theatre series in Missoula.
